message: Template condition references boundary 'PartnerBoundary_2026_06_22' but submitted boundary is named 'PartnerBoundary_2026_06_24' — condition will never match, causing AccessDenied on CreateRole

Boundary grants iam:CreateRole, iam:AttachRolePolicy, and iam:PutRolePolicy on arn:aws:iam::*:role/partner-managed/* without iam:PermissionsBoundary condition — enables privilege escalation via unbounded sub-role creation
